messages:
Iris: small proposal - surface per-tenant fanout policy in SLO editor so teams can pick: immediate | condensed | escalate.
Devon: condensed = group alerts into a digest when tenant exceeds fanout_budget.
Wei: API change idea: optional field `fanout_policy` in notify and notify-preview. Preview should return `mode` and `budget_remaining`.
Sam: Telemetry needs: `slo.notify.mode` + `slo.notify.effective_count` labeled by tenant,slo_id,policy. Sample at 100% for first 48h.
Iris: UI should show preview recipients and a small warning: "If policy=condensed, P0 still immediate by default."
Devon: Runtime: budget tokens/hour, immediate=1, digest=5. Bypass for severity==P0 or impact_confidence>0.85.
Wei: Rollout: enable via rollout-service 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> all. At each step run 24h checks: if time_to_ack up >30% for key tenants, rollback.
preview-bot: preview-api v1.9 deployed to staging (ok).
Sam: I'll add dashboards: mode breakdown and per-tenant budget remaining. Also add alert if condensed mode >10% prod tenants >30m.
Iris: Thanks, will open API PR and mock the preview endpoint contract. Sync tomorrow 11:00. :thumbsup:
